ops.new: directive quoted as one line where the platform expands it into two). **One exception — a read-back your protocol SANCTIONS:** where your active protocol explicitly sanctions a read-back of a file your package itself authored (the deployed file itself is the witnessed artifact, not a rendering of it), the lines your package wrote into that file may be the expected output of that read-back step — quote exactly what its command PRINTS, never a description of it. Anything a device or tool RENDERS from what you wrote (e.g. a show command, a plan, an API response, a rendered manifest) stays under the rule above, and so does every read your protocol does not sanction as such a read-back: a protocol calling a read verbatim, or a rendering yours, is not that sanction
